kevin-runtime: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector change rolled yesterday we saw a +18% p95 token latency on the medium-length chat route (route: /v1/chat/gen-medium). Threading this here to coordinate root cause and dashboard instrumentation.

maria-ml: Ugh. I suspected kernel fallback might be happening. Any traces showing which kernel variant was used?

kevin-runtime: deploy-bot: Deployed runtime v3.2.1 to us-west1 at 14:02 UTC yesterday. Kernel selector config `prefer_fast_wmma: true`. We switched default from `autoselect` to `policy=performance`.

ashley-sre: Noted. From infra metrics: overall GPU SM occupancy dropped ~12% on affected hosts, but VRAM usage actually increased slightly (maybe due to bigger KV cache snapshots?).

nate-platform: Can we get token-level latency breakdowns for the route? Need to know if the hit is in attention kernel, KV lookup, or tokenization/dispatch.

kevin-runtime: I pulled a quick perf profile across a 1h window (attached below). The strong signal is in attention kernel time + queue wait. KV cache local lookup looks stable.

kevin-runtime: ```
# sample aggregated metrics (us-west1, 1h)
route: /v1/chat/gen-medium
p50_token_ms: 7.1
p95_token_ms: 24.8  # before: 21.0
attention_kernel_ms: +22% vs baseline
kv_lookup_ms: +3% vs baseline
dispatch_queue_ms: +40% during spikes
SM_occupancy: 68% -> 56%
GPU_VRAM_util: 72% -> 77%
power_W: ~260W steady
thermal_C: +2C
```

maria-ml: Interesting VRAM up but occupancy down — could be due to suboptimal kernel tiling that increases per-thread memory footprint and reduces active warps. Also `prefer_fast_wmma` tends to pick WMMA kernels that are great for big dense matrices but can underperform on shorter sequence lengths.

ashley-sre: Agreed. Also noticed occasional MIG slice changes on two of the nodes (ops-bot reported MIG reassignments during the maintenance window). That could cause reduced SM availability per instance and explain some queueing.

ops-bot: MIG-manager: Rebalanced slices on gpu-node-13 during maintenance at 2025-09-21T03:40:10Z (reason: capacity reclaim).

nate-platform: So likely a combo: new kernel policy picked WMMA variant -> larger register/shared memory -> fewer active warps -> lower SM occupancy. If MIG slices changed, per-GPU SM count for some pods decreased too, amplifying queue waits.

kevin-runtime: Proposal: revert to `policy=autoselect` for gen-medium for now, add token-level histogram and per-route stack traces to the dashboard, and instrument kernel-choice counts (which kernel selected per request). Want to add a per-route KPI card: p50/p95 token latency, attention_kernel_pct, queue_wait_ms, SM_occupancy, VRAM_pct, MIG_slice_count.

maria-ml: +1 on instrumentation. For kernel-selection counts let's log a small enum per request: `kernel: wmma_v2 | gemm_tiled | fused_attn`. Keep the logging path lightweight (sample 1% or by spike).

ashley-sre: For dashboards — can we add an alert: if SM_occupancy drops >10% and p95_token_ms increases >10% within 5m, fire a Sev2? That ties hardware utilization to user impact.

nate-platform: I'll add the dashboard changes in grafana/provisioning. Fields we should surface: `kernel_choice`, `kernel_latency_ms`, `kv_hit_ratio`, `queue_wait_ms`, `SM_occupancy_pct`, `VRAM_used_pct`, `gpu_power_w`, `gpu_temp_c`, `mig_slices`. Also a per-route rollup panel for these metrics.

kevin-runtime: I can open a quick PR to: 1) flip policy back, 2) add kernel_choice metric emission, 3) add a sampled token-latency trace. Want to test on staging with MIG slices artificially reduced to reproduce.

maria-ml: For staging reproducer, we can run sequence length distribution matching gen-medium. I'll drop a script in `perf/reproducers/` and a config to force `prefer_fast_wmma` so we can measure occupancy differences.

kevin-runtime: Sounds good. Timeline? If we revert in prod now, we can buy time while dashboards/alerts are added.

ashley-sre: Please revert now. I'll watch the SLO dashboards and annotate the incident. After that's stable, we can push the observability additions.

kevin-runtime: Reverted to `autoselect` in us-west1 at 15:04 UTC. Rolling restart completed. Will follow up with a short postmortem and the dashboard PR.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Revert commit ae3f9 -> runtime-config restored, restart jobs started.

kevin-runtime: Post-revert quick check: p95 token latency down to 21.3ms, SM occupancy back to ~67%, queue_wait spikes reduced. Leaving this thread open until dashboard/alerts are in. :white_check_mark:
